company.name: LUMICKS
company.shortDescription: LUMICKS provides single-molecule analysis technologies for cancer research and immunotherapy.
company.description: LUMICKS delivers state-of-the-art technologies for the study of biology and cancer at the single-molecule and single-cell levels. It aims to build the unfinished bridge between structure and function at the molecular and cellular levels. Using its product C-Trap Optical Tweezers, Fluorescence Microscopy, scientists are able to analyze complex biological processes in real-time. Similarly, the z-Movi Cell Avidity Analyzer enables the measurement and selection of immune cells based on their real-time interactions with target cells.

productsAndServices.description: A dynamic single-molecule microscope that combines optical tweezers, fluorescence and label-free microscopy to manipulate, visualize and measure biomolecular interactions in real time.
productsAndServices.name: C-Trap®

productsAndServices.description: A high-throughput Cell Avidity platform for measuring the strength of interactions between cells or between cells and proteins in immunotherapy research.
productsAndServices.name: Avidion

productsAndServices.description: An instrument for small-scale Cell Avidity studies that measures cell–cell or cell–protein interaction strength using acoustic force and fluorescence imaging.
productsAndServices.name: z-Movi® Cell Avidity Analyzer

productsAndServices.description: A contract research service that provides Cell Avidity experimental design, measurements, data analysis and interpretation for academic and industry customers.
productsAndServices.name: Avidigo Services

productsAndServices.description: Research consumables and reagents that support LUMICKS Dynamic Single-Molecule experiments and instrument workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Consumables & Reagents

productsAndServices.description: Scientific application support, technical assistance, demonstrations, workshops, grant support and user education for LUMICKS technologies.
productsAndServices.name: Application and Technical Support Services
